scripts.build: npm run build:bundle && npm run build:types
scripts.build:types: node cli/bin/pbts --main --global protobuf --out index.d.ts src/ lib/aspromise/index.js lib/base64/index.js lib/codegen/index.js lib/eventemitter/index.js lib/float/index.js lib/fetch/index.js lib/path/index.js lib/pool/index.js lib/utf8/index.js
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:test && npm run coverage:report
scripts.lint: npm run lint:sources && npm run lint:types
scripts.prepublish: cd cli && npm install && cd .. && npm run build
scripts.prepublishOnly: cd cli && npm install && cd .. && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:sources && npm run test:types
scripts.test:types: tsc tests/comp_typescript.ts --lib es2015 --esModuleInterop --strictNullChecks --experimentalDecorators --emitDecoratorMetadata && tsc tests/data/test.js.ts --lib es2015 --esModuleInterop --noEmit --strictNullChecks && tsc tests/data/*.ts --lib es2015 --esModuleInterop --noEmit --strictNullChecks
scripts.make: npm run lint:sources && npm run build && npm run lint:types && node ./scripts/gentests.js && npm test
